components.title: Top navigation / drop-down menus
components.summary: The header, menu groups (Operate, AI & Tools, ...) and their links.
components.how_to_edit: Add or rename a <a href> inside the matching <details class='nav-group'> block. Group open/active state is the request.path.startswith(...) test on the <details> line.

files.role: LIVE nav (this is what is rendered)
Older copy of the layout and nav (shadowed)

components.warning: The nav is defined TWICE. main.py's HTML_TEMPLATE overrides the one imported from templates/base.py, so pages show main.py's version. Change both until they are merged.

components.title: Logo
components.summary: The MasterChief logo shown in the header and on standalone pages.
components.how_to_edit: Replace static/masterchief-logo.svg to change the image everywhere. To change size or alt text edit the tag in the files below.

files.role: Injects the logo into standalone .html pages

components.title: App version
components.summary: The version number for packaging, PyPI, and the About page.
components.how_to_edit: Change version= in setup.py for the package/PyPI version. The About page shows the latest version from GitHub (GITHUB_REPO env var), not setup.py.

files.role: Fetches the GitHub version for About

components.title: About page
components.summary: The About page content.
components.how_to_edit: Edit about.html (plain HTML in the project root).

components.title: System diagnostics
components.summary: Diagnostics page and scan APIs.
components.how_to_edit: Edit the route logic in the blueprint and the HTML in templates/diagnostics.py.

components.title: Echo Chat page (UI)
components.summary: What you see on /echo-chat: layout, styles, front-end script.
components.how_to_edit: Layout/HTML: ECHO_CHAT_TEMPLATE in main.py. Look and feel: static/echo_chat.css. Browser behaviour: static/echo_chat.js.

components.title: Echo Chat brain and API
components.summary: How Echo answers: commands, memory, script library, app-change orders.
components.how_to_edit: Replies and commands: echo/chat_bot.py. HTTP endpoint and admin command handling (!confirmed, !cancelchange): api_echo_chat in main.py.

files.role: The chat bot (reply logic, script reference index)

components.title: Echo Approvals
components.summary: Review and approve changes Echo proposes.
components.how_to_edit: Page markup: templates/echo_approvals.html. Data/diffs: managers/echo_change_approvals.py. Routes: main.py.

components.title: Echo training and memory pages
components.summary: Training and memory UIs.
components.how_to_edit: Edit the page templates and their routes.

components.title: Data Backups
components.summary: Zip backup of data/.
components.how_to_edit: UI: templates/data_backups.html. Logic: managers/data_backup.py. Routes: main.py.

components.title: CI/CD Center
components.summary: Workflow trigger analysis, deploy target selection, triggers.
components.how_to_edit: UI: templates/cicd.html. Logic and providers: managers/cicd_center.py. Routes: main.py. Pipelines themselves: .github/workflows/*.yml. Saved settings go to data/cicd_config.json (created on first save).

components.title: Source Control page (git buttons)
components.summary: Commit / push / pull from the UI.
components.how_to_edit: Routes call git via subprocess. main.py has a duplicate copy of these routes.

components.title: Idea Basket and Chaos Monkey
components.summary: Idea basket panel inside /chaos-monkey.
components.how_to_edit: Panel HTML: templates/core_scripts.html (#ideas-panel). API and storage: blueprints/core_scripts.py.

components.title: Code UI (script library)
components.summary: masterchief_code_ui: browse and manage scripts.
components.how_to_edit: Page served by ui_pages; script indexing lives in the Echo bot and the script index modules.

components.title: ChatServ (IRC)
components.summary: Chat server page, model controls.
components.how_to_edit: UI: templates/chatserv.html and static/chatserv_controls.js. Routes: blueprints/chatserv_routes.py.

components.title: Login and roles
components.summary: Users, passwords, permissions.
components.how_to_edit: Runtime user data is data/rbac.json (hashed passwords - do not hand-edit or commit). Admin UI: rbac.html.

components.title: Python dependencies
components.summary: What pip installs.
components.how_to_edit: requirements.txt is required; requirements-optional.txt holds heavy AI/audio packages (torch, diffusers).

components.title: Page Editor
components.summary: Pick a page, see every file/block behind it, edit with diff, backup and restore.
components.how_to_edit: UI: templates/page_editor.html. Logic and safety rules (allowed folders/types, backups): managers/page_editor.py. Routes: main.py. Backups go to data/page_editor_backups/. Each segment links to the Web IDE (/masterchief_code_ui?open=path&line=N) and VS Code.

files.role: Finds segments, validates and saves edits

components.title: Site Settings wizard
components.summary: Forms to change the logo, browser title, version, About page text and menu entries. Each change shows a diff and keeps a backup.
components.how_to_edit: Add or change a setting: edit the FIELDS list (file + regex per setting) in managers/site_settings.py. Page layout: templates/site_settings.html. Routes: main.py (/site-settings, /api/site-settings/*).

files.role: Which setting edits which file (FIELDS), menu and logo logic
Validated, backed-up writes used by every edit

components.title: Source Map 3D view
components.summary: Rotatable map of components and the files they use, with Web IDE and VS Code links.
components.how_to_edit: Drawing and layout: static/source_map_3d.js. Page wiring: templates/source_map.html. Data comes from docs/source_map.json.

files.role: Component registry shown in the map

notes: Open a file link with VS Code installed to jump straight to the line.
Temporary helper scripts used to apply edits are deleted after use; anything permanent lives in tools/.
